prompt_inputs.goal: Strength training and muscle recovery for weightlifting competition in 2 weeks
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Vegetarian, no more than 30 minutes total meal prep time

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals and includes at least 2 vegetarian protein sources per day (e.g., legumes, dairy, nuts, tofu)
Provides adequate protein for muscle recovery (approximately 1.6-2.2g per kg body weight)
All meals can be prepared or assembled in 30 minutes total or use quick/no-prep options
Includes recovery-focused nutrition (carbohydrates post-workout, electrolytes, micronutrients)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-based athlete (weightlifter) with dietary restrictions (vegetarian) and limited meal prep time, emphasizing protein sources and recovery nutrition

prompt_inputs.goal: High-performance nutrition for competitive swimming with training sessions at 6:00 AM and 4:00 PM

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals plus snacks timed appropriately around swim training sessions
All meals and snacks are nut-free and dairy-free
Includes hydration strategy with fluid intake recommendations around workouts
Meals are practical, concise, and achievable within 1 day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (swimmer) having allergies (nuts and dairy) and needing meals timed around training sessions with hydration considerations

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon race day nutrition - high carbohydrate loading with sustained energy for 42km endurance event

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one full day with compact formatting
Total daily calories support high endurance athlete needs (approximately 3000-3500 kcal)
Macronutrient ratio emphasizes carbohydrates (60-65%), moderate protein (15-20%), and healthy fats (15-20%)
Includes practical timing and portion sizes suitable for marathon preparation
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading, with specific macronutrient ratios
